name: batch.run
description: Execute multiple operations in a single IPC call (~400ms total instead of 400ms × N). Operations run sequentially inside ONE undo group — a single Ctrl+Z reverts the whole batch, however many ops it contained. Operations requiring execution outside an undo group (project.open, project.new, project.undo, command.execute id 16/2035) are rejected here: call those as their own ae_do. If one fails, subsequent ops still run unless stopOnError. Results array matches input order; the response reports how many failed. Mix in read/verify children — comp.info, layer.info, render.frame — to mutate AND verify in the same call, e.g. [...mutations, { operation: 'render.frame', args: { … } }].

params.name: ops
params.description: Array of { operation, args } objects, e.g. [{ "operation": "layer.create_solid", "args": { "comp": "Main", "color": [1,0,0] } }]

params.name: stopOnError
params.description: Stop executing remaining ops if one fails (default false)

name: command.execute
description: Execute an AE menu command by its numeric ID. Use command.list to discover common IDs. Undo (16) and Redo (2035) run outside this call's undo group, so they revert/replay the PREVIOUS call.

name: command.find
description: Find a menu command ID by name (AE's app.findMenuCommandId). Note: not reliable across languages.

name: command.list
description: Return a curated list of commonly-used menu command IDs.

name: comp.add_guide
description: Add a horizontal or vertical guide line to a comp (AE 16.1+).

params.name: position
params.description: Position in px (y for horizontal, x for vertical)

name: comp.create
description: Create a new composition.

name: comp.delete
description: Delete a composition from the project.

name: comp.duplicate
description: Duplicate a composition.

params.name: comp
params.description: Comp name or id to duplicate

name: comp.info
description: Comp details + per-layer summaries (same payload as ae_comp_info). As a batch.run child, lets the same call verify what a preceding mutation did.

name: comp.list_guides
description: List all guides on a comp with orientation and position (AE 16.1+).

name: comp.list_renderers
description: List the comp's available 3D renderer matchNames, the current one, and the friendly-name mapping used by comp.set_renderer.

name: comp.precompose
description: Pre-compose selected layers into a new nested composition.

params.name: layerIndices
params.description: Array of 1-based layer indices to precompose

params.name: moveAll
params.description: Move all attributes into new comp (default true)

name: comp.remove_guide
description: Remove a guide from a comp by its 0-based index (see comp.list_guides).

name: comp.resize
description: Change a comp's size and keep its content where it was: every unparented layer's Position (keyframes included, separated dimensions handled) is offset so the content stays pinned to `anchor` — 'center' keeps it centred, 'topLeft' keeps the top-left corner, etc. Children follow their parents. Comp accepts a name, id, pattern, or array.

params.name: comp
params.description: Comp name/id, pattern ('shot_*'), or array of those

params.name: anchor
params.description: Where the existing content stays pinned: center | topLeft | topCenter | topRight | centerLeft | centerRight | bottomLeft | bottomCenter | bottomRight (default center)

params.name: offset
params.description: [dx, dy] explicit offset applied to every unparented layer instead of `anchor`

name: comp.sample
description: Sample property values at several times across layers of one or more comps in ONE call. Each row says whether the layer is active at that time (enabled and inside its in/out span) and gives the post-expression value of every requested property (default: the five transform properties). Use it to verify motion, list what is visible when, or compare two comps for a match cut.

params.name: comp
params.description: Comp name/id, pattern ('shot_*'), or array of those

params.name: layer
params.description: Layer filter: index | name | { id } | 'selected' | 'all' | array (default 'all')

params.name: properties
params.description: Property paths to read, e.g. [["Transform","Position"], ["Effects","Slider Control","Slider"]] (default: the five transform properties)

params.name: activeOnly
params.description: Omit layers that are not active at the sampled time (default false)

name: comp.set_guide
description: Move an existing guide to a new position (Item.setGuide). Orientation cannot be changed after creation — remove and re-add instead.

params.name: position
params.description: New position in px (y for horizontal, x for vertical)

name: comp.set_label
description: Set label color on comps. Can target by name, id, or pattern (e.g. 'review_id_*').

params.name: comp
params.description: Comp name/id, or pattern with '*' wildcard

name: comp.set_layer_order
description: Arrange layers by listing them top to bottom. The listed layers occupy startIndex.. in that order; unlisted layers keep their relative order below (or above) them.

params.name: layers
params.description: Layer references (index | name | { id }), top first

params.name: startIndex
params.description: 1-based index the first listed layer lands on (default 1 = top)

name: comp.set_props
description: Set composition properties (bgColor, workAreaStart, workAreaDuration, shutterAngle, motionBlur, etc.).

name: comp.set_renderer
description: Switch a comp's 3D renderer: classic3d | advanced3d | cinema4d (or a raw matchName from comp.list_renderers). Advanced 3D is required for 3D model layers, parametric meshes, and environment lights to render.

params.name: renderer
params.description: classic3d|advanced3d|cinema4d, or an exact renderer matchName

name: comp.set_work_area
description: Set the work area start and duration on a composition.

name: effect.add
description: Add an effect to a layer by matchName. Use ae_do project.list_effects (or effect.list_on_layer on a reference layer) to find matchNames.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: name
params.description: Custom display name for the effect

name: effect.get_dropdown_items
description: Read a Dropdown Menu Control's items (Property.propertyParameters, AE 26.0+), current 1-based selection, and its text (valueText).

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: effect
params.description: 1-based effect index or effect name (a Dropdown Menu Control)

name: effect.list_on_layer
description: List all effects currently applied to a layer with their matchNames and properties.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: effect.move
description: Reorder an effect within a layer's effect stack (PropertyBase.moveTo). Effect order changes the render result.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: effectIndex
params.description: 1-based index of the effect to move

name: effect.remove
description: Remove an effect by its 1-based index within the layer's Effects group.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: effect.set_dropdown_items
description: Set the menu items of a Dropdown Menu Control effect (Property.setPropertyParameters, AE 17.0.1+) — the key API for MOGRT dropdowns. Item strings must be unique; "-" inserts a separator. AE re-creates the control (references from earlier calls become invalid); this op preserves the effect's display name across that re-creation.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: effect
params.description: 1-based effect index or effect name (a Dropdown Menu Control)

name: effect.set_property
description: Set a property value on an effect. Property path is relative to the effect (e.g. ['Blurriness'] for Gaussian Blur).

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: time
params.description: If set, creates a keyframe at this time

name: egp.add_layer
description: Expose a whole LAYER in a comp's Essential Graphics panel as a Media Replacement controller (AVLayer.addToMotionGraphicsTemplate, AE 18.0+). For single properties use egp.add_property.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: masterComp
params.description: Template master comp (default: same as comp)

params.name: controllerName
params.description: Display name in the Essential Graphics panel (default: layer name)

name: egp.add_property
description: Expose a layer property in the Essential Graphics panel of a comp (Property.addToMotionGraphicsTemplateAs). The comp becomes the template master.

params.name: comp
params.description: Comp name or id (holds the property)

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: controllerName
params.description: Display name in the Essential Graphics panel (default: property name)

name: egp.export_mogrt
description: Export a comp as a Motion Graphics Template (.mogrt) file for Premiere Pro (CompItem.exportAsMotionGraphicsTemplate).

params.name: path
params.description: Absolute destination FOLDER (the filename comes from the template name). Omit to save into the user's Motion Graphics Templates folder. Save the project first — a dirty project triggers a save prompt.

params.name: overwrite
params.description: Overwrite an existing file without asking (default true)

name: egp.list_controllers
description: List the Essential Graphics controllers exposed on a comp (AE 16.1+ for controller names).

name: egp.open_in_panel
description: Open a comp in the Essential Graphics panel as the template master (CompItem.openInEssentialGraphics, AE 15.0+).

name: egp.set_alternate_source
description: Set a Media Replacement alternate source on an Essential Properties source (Property.setAlternateSource, AE 18.0+). Works on layers of a template comp opened from Essential Graphics.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: property
params.description: Property path to the media-replacement essential property

params.name: item
params.description: Replacement source: project item id (number) or name (string)

name: egp.set_name
description: Set the Motion Graphics Template name of a comp (Essential Graphics panel title).

name: expression.disable_all
description: Disable all expressions in a comp (all layers, all properties). Returns a manifest that can be used to re-enable them later via expression.restore_all. Manifest paths use numeric property indices; manifests produced by older versions of this operation (matchName-based paths) are not compatible.

name: expression.remove
description: Remove (disable) the expression on a property.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: expression.restore_all
description: Re-enable expressions from a manifest produced by expression.disable_all. Optionally transform the expressions before restoring (e.g. replace content variable). Only manifests in the current format (numeric property-index paths) are supported; manifests from older versions are not compatible.

params.name: replacements
params.description: Optional string replacements to apply to each expression before restoring, e.g. { "old": "new" }

name: expression.set
description: Apply an expression to a property.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: folder.create
description: Create a folder in the project panel, optionally inside another folder.

params.name: parent
params.description: Parent folder id or name (default: project root)

name: font.check_glyphs
description: Check whether a font has glyphs for every character of a string (FontObject.hasGlyphsFor, AE 25.1+). Essential before setting CJK or symbol text on a Latin-only font.

name: font.get_default_for_script
description: Read the default font for a writing script (FontsObject.getDefaultFontForCTScript, AE 25.1+): roman|japanese|arabic|cyrillic|greek|hebrew|thai|devanagari, or a raw CTScript member name like CT_HANGUL_SCRIPT.

name: font.get_lists
description: Read the Character panel's Favorites and most-recently-used font family lists (AE 24.6+).

name: font.info
description: Full FontObject details for a font (AE 24.0+): names, location, Adobe Fonts / substitute flags, and variable-font design axes (designAxesData/designVector). Look up by postScriptName, or by family (+ optional style).

name: font.list
description: List installed fonts with postScriptName/family/style (app.fonts, AE 24.0+). Use postScriptName with text.set_style. Filter with familyContains.

params.name: familyContains
params.description: Case-insensitive substring match on family name

name: font.list_duplicates
description: List groups of installed fonts that share a PostScript name (FontsObject.fontsDuplicateByPostScriptName, AE 24.6+) — the usual cause of 'wrong font picked' surprises.

name: font.list_missing
description: List fonts that are missing or substituted in the current project (app.fonts, AE 24.0+). Pair with project.replace_font to fix.

name: font.list_used
description: List every font used in the project with its usage references (Project.usedFonts, AE 24.5+). The reverse of font.list_missing: answers 'which fonts does this project depend on'.

name: font.set_default_for_script
description: Set the default font AE uses for a writing script (FontsObject.setDefaultFontForCTScript, AE 25.1+). Script names as in font.get_default_for_script; font by PostScript name.

params.name: confirm
params.description: Must be true. This operation changes the user's After Effects APPLICATION configuration (it persists beyond the project) — set it only when the user explicitly requested this change, never as a side effect of other work.

name: font.set_favorites
description: Replace the Character panel's Favorites font family list (FontsObject.favoriteFontFamilyList, AE 24.6+).

params.name: families
params.description: Font family names, in display order

params.name: confirm
params.description: Must be true. This operation changes the user's After Effects APPLICATION configuration (it persists beyond the project) — set it only when the user explicitly requested this change, never as a side effect of other work.

name: font.set_substitution
description: Configure automatic replacement of substituted (missing) fonts (AE 24.6+): matchPolicy postScriptName|ctfiEqual|disabled, and freezeSync to stop Adobe Fonts auto-sync on project open.

params.name: freezeSync
params.description: Suppress Adobe Fonts auto-sync of substituted fonts

params.name: confirm
params.description: Must be true. This operation changes the user's After Effects APPLICATION configuration (it persists beyond the project) — set it only when the user explicitly requested this change, never as a side effect of other work.

name: footage.interpret
description: Set footage interpretation: alpha mode, frame rate conform, looping, fields, pixel aspect (FootageItem.mainSource).

params.name: conformFrameRate
params.description: Conform to this frame rate (0 = native)

params.name: loop
params.description: Number of times to loop the footage

name: footage.list_missing
description: List footage items whose source file is missing (footageMissing), with the last-known path. The footage counterpart of font.list_missing.

name: footage.reload
description: Reload a footage item from its source file (FileSource.reload) — picks up external edits to the file without relinking.

name: footage.replace
description: Relink a footage item to a different file (FootageItem.replace). Layers using the item keep keyframes/effects. Pass sequence=true to relink to an image sequence.

params.name: path
params.description: Absolute path to the new file

params.name: sequence
params.description: Treat path as the first file of an image sequence (default false)

params.name: forceAlphabetical
params.description: Sequence only: force alphabetical order (default false)

name: footage.replace_with_placeholder
description: Replace a footage item's source with a placeholder (FootageItem.replaceWithPlaceholder) — e.g. to stand in for footage that will arrive later. Layers keep keyframes/effects.

name: footage.replace_with_solid
description: Replace a footage item's source with a solid color (FootageItem.replaceWithSolid). Layers using the item keep keyframes/effects.

name: footage.set_proxy
description: Set or clear a proxy on any project item (comp or footage): a file, an image sequence, a solid color, or a placeholder. Omit path/solidColor/placeholder to remove the proxy.

params.name: path
params.description: Absolute path to the proxy file — omit to remove the proxy

params.name: sequence
params.description: Treat path as the first file of an image sequence (default false)

params.name: solidColor
params.description: [r,g,b] 0-1 — set a solid proxy instead of a file (setProxyWithSolid)

params.name: placeholder
params.description: Set a placeholder proxy sized like the item (setProxyWithPlaceholder)

name: instance.dialogs
description: List the modal dialogs every running After Effects is showing — the message text, the owning process and its window title, and an id for instance.dismiss_dialog. While a dialog is open no script runs (calls fail with DIALOG_OPEN, or an instance stops ticking), and the dialog is often hidden behind the main window. Windows and macOS. On macOS the text is read only with Accessibility permission for the app running this server; without it dialogs are still listed, with empty text (`accessibility: false`).

name: instance.dismiss_dialog
description: Close a modal dialog After Effects is showing by its cancel action (what Escape does). A warning (missing files or fonts, a script alert) is acknowledged; a question is cancelled, never answered: "Save changes before closing?" leaves the project open and unsaved. Take `id` from instance.dialogs or from a DIALOG_OPEN error's details.dialogs. When the user wants a dialog answered some other way (Save, Replace…), ask them to click it. Windows and macOS; on macOS it needs Accessibility permission. A dialog Escape does not close is left open unless it has a single button (an OK-only warning), which is pressed.

params.name: id
params.description: The dialog's id, as listed by instance.dialogs

name: instance.list
description: List the After Effects instances whose resident agent is live — id, open project, busy state — and which one this call would address. Instances are separate After Effects processes (AfterFX.exe -m), each with its own project; address one on any tool with `instance: <id or project name>`. Stale entries are instances that quit or stopped ticking (a modal dialog blocks scripting).

name: instance.start
description: Start a NEW After Effects instance (AfterFX.exe -m) named `name`, wait until its agent registers, and optionally open a project in it — or a COPY of one (`copyFrom`), which is the safe way to work on a project another instance already has open (two instances saving one file overwrite each other). Returns when the instance can be addressed with `instance: name` on every tool. Cold starts take 10–40 s. Parallel workflow: instance.start { name: 'w1', copyFrom: <main .aep> } → work with instance: 'w1' → ae_save_project (instance: 'w1') → project.merge { path: <the copy> } on the main instance → instance.stop { name: 'w1' }. Requires the resident agent (npx @kumoproductions/mcp-aftereffects install-agent) — every instance loads it at launch.

params.name: name
params.description: Instance id — becomes AE_MCP_INSTANCE for the new process. Letters, digits, '.', '_', '-'. Must not be live already.

params.name: project
params.description: Absolute .aep path to open in the new instance once it is up.

params.name: copyFrom
params.description: Absolute .aep path to COPY first; the copy is what gets opened. Use for a project the main instance has open.

params.name: copyTo
params.description: Where `copyFrom` is copied to (default: next to the original as <stem>__<name>.aep). Overwritten if present.

params.name: timeoutMs
params.description: How long to wait for the instance to register (default 120000).

name: instance.stop
description: Quit an After Effects instance by name. Refuses while the project has unsaved changes unless `save: true` (save in place — the project must have a file) or `discardChanges: true`. Returns once the instance has gone quiet after acknowledging a scheduled quit. stopped describes agent quietness; exitConfirmed is false because heartbeat silence does not prove process exit. Use on workers you started with instance.start; it works on any live instance, so check instance.list before stopping one you did not start.

params.name: save
params.description: Save the project to its existing file before quitting (default false)

params.name: discardChanges
params.description: Quit even if the project has unsaved changes (default false)

params.name: timeoutMs
params.description: How long to wait for the instance to go quiet (default 30000).

name: item.list
description: List project items, optionally filtered by folder, type, or name substring. Lighter than ae_project_info for targeted lookups.

params.name: folder
params.description: Only items directly inside this folder (id or name)

params.name: nameContains
params.description: Case-insensitive substring match on item name

name: item.move_to_folder
description: Move a project item (comp, footage, or folder) into a folder. Pass folder=null for the project root.

params.name: folder
params.description: Target folder id or name — null for project root

name: item.set_props
description: Set project-item properties: name, label color (0-16), comment, selected. Works on comps, footage, and folders.

name: item.usages
description: Reverse lookup: list every comp that uses a footage item or comp (AVItem.usedIn), with the layer indices that reference it.

name: keyframe.add
description: Add a keyframe at a specific time with a value.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: keyframe.apply
description: Write a whole keyframe list to a property in ONE call, easing included: keys = [{ time, value, interp?, inType?, outType?, inInfluence?, outInfluence?, inSpeed?, outSpeed? }]. interp: linear | ease (both sides bezier) | easeIn (in bezier, out linear) | easeOut | hold (OUT side only — the incoming segment keeps evaluating, unlike keyframe.set_easing's symmetric 'hold') | keep. Handles separated dimensions (X/Y Position followers) and __kind values (Shape, TextDocument). replace=true clears existing keys first. Applies the same list to every matched layer.

params.name: layer
params.description: Layer index, name, { id }, 'selected', 'all', or an array of those

params.name: keys
params.description: [{ time, value, interp?, inType?, outType?, inInfluence?, outInfluence?, inSpeed?, outSpeed? }, …]

params.name: interp
params.description: Default interp for keys that do not set their own (default: AE's default, i.e. keep)

params.name: replace
params.description: Remove the property's existing keys first (default false)

params.name: spatialTangents
params.description: auto | linear — 'linear' zeroes the spatial tangents on Position/Anchor keys so the motion path is straight between keys (default auto = AE's auto-bezier)

name: keyframe.copy
description: Copy all keyframes from one property to another (same or different layer/comp). Value types must be compatible. Existing target keys are kept.

params.name: targetProperty
params.description: Target property path (default: same as source)

params.name: timeOffset
params.description: Seconds to add to every copied key time (default 0)

name: keyframe.remove
description: Remove a keyframe by its 1-based index.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: keyframe.set_batch
description: Set many keyframes on one property in a single call (Property.setValuesAtTimes). times and values must have the same length.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: keyframe.set_easing
description: Apply easing to a keyframe. Preset: 'linear', 'ease', 'easeIn', 'easeOut', 'hold'. Or custom bezier with inSpeed/outSpeed/inInfluence/outInfluence. NOTE: 'hold' here sets BOTH sides to HOLD, which also freezes the segment BEFORE the key (a fade ending in such a key never fades). For the timeline's Toggle-Hold behaviour (out side only) use keyframe.set_interpolation outType:'hold' or keyframe.apply interp:'hold'.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: keyframe.set_interpolation
description: Set a keyframe's in/out interpolation types directly (linear|bezier|hold — asymmetric combinations allowed, e.g. bezier in / hold out), and the temporal continuous / auto-bezier flags. For speed/influence curves use keyframe.set_easing.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: temporalAutoBezier
params.description: Temporal auto-bezier flag (true also enables continuity)

name: keyframe.set_label
description: Set a keyframe's label color (Property.setLabelAtKey, AE 22.6+).

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: keyframe.set_roving
description: Set a keyframe to rove across time (smooth speed on a spatial path). First and last keyframes cannot rove.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: keyframe.set_selected
description: Select or deselect keyframes on a property (Property.setSelectedAtKey) - e.g. to stage keys for a user-facing copy/paste in the UI.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: keyframe.set_spatial
description: Set spatial tangents / continuity on a keyframe of a spatial property (Position, Anchor Point). Tangents are [x,y] or [x,y,z] offsets.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: keyframe.set_value
description: Change the value of an existing keyframe without changing its time.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: keyframe.shift
description: Retime all keyframes on a property: newTime = (time - pivot) * scale + pivot + offset. Preserves interpolation, ease, and spatial tangents best-effort.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: pivot
params.description: Pivot time in seconds for scaling (default 0)

name: layer.add_guide
description: Add a ruler guide to a layer's Layer panel view (Layer.addGuide, AE 16.1+). Comp-panel guides live under comp.add_guide.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: position
params.description: Position in px (y for horizontal, x for vertical)

name: layer.apply_preset
description: Apply an animation preset (.ffx file) to a layer — applies effects/keyframes in one call.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: layer.bounds
description: Measure a layer's rendered bounds via sourceRectAtTime — essential for aligning/fitting text and shape layers. Returns layer-space rect and, when the host supports it, comp-space corners.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: time
params.description: Time in seconds (default: current comp time)

params.name: includeExtents
params.description: Include pixel extents beyond the layer edges (default false)

name: layer.calculate_transform
description: Calculate the transform that maps a 3D layer onto three corner points (AVLayer.calculateTransformFromPoints) - corner-pin style placement in 3D space. Calculation-only: returns anchorPoint/position/x-y-zRotation/scale without touching the layer — apply them with property.set / layer.set_props.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name (3D layer)

params.name: topLeft
params.description: [x,y,z] world point for the layer's top-left

params.name: bottomLeft
params.description: [x,y,z] world point for the bottom-left. The scripting guide names this pointBottomRight, but the implementation expects the bottom-left (the guide's own example passes bl): a true bottom-right returns the same placement with zScale skewed by sin(corner angle) — verified on AE 26.3.

name: layer.convert_point
description: Convert a point between layer source space and comp space (sourcePointToComp / compPointToSource, AE 13.2+; designed for text layers — evaluates at the first character at the given time).

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: time
params.description: Evaluate at this time (default: current comp time)

name: layer.convert_to_shapes
description: Run 'Create Shapes from Vector Layer' on imported Illustrator/vector layers: each becomes a shape layer directly above the original (which AE switches off). By default the ' Outlines' suffix AE appends is stripped; removeSource deletes the vector layers, removeFootage also deletes their footage items when nothing else uses them. Note: the shape layers can arrive with Position dimensions SEPARATED — every write in this server handles that.

params.name: layer
params.description: Layer index, name, { id }, 'selected', 'all', or an array of those (shape layers)

params.name: stripSuffix
params.description: Rename the new layer to the original's name (drop ' Outlines' / localized suffix). Default true

params.name: removeSource
params.description: Delete the original vector layer after conversion (default false)

params.name: removeFootage
params.description: With removeSource: also delete the footage item when no other layer uses it (default false)

name: layer.copy_to_comp
description: Copy a layer into another comp. The copy is identified by its Layer.id (never by assuming it landed on top). Options: timeOffset/startTime to place it in time, bakeAtTime to freeze every animated property at that source time and drop the keys (match-cut copies), name to rename. The copy keeps the source comp's span — use layer.set_timing outPoint:'comp' to extend it.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, name, or { id } in the source comp

params.name: timeOffset
params.description: Seconds added to the copy's startTime

params.name: startTime
params.description: Absolute startTime for the copy (applied after timeOffset)

params.name: bakeAtTime
params.description: Freeze every keyframed property of the copy at this SOURCE-comp time and remove its keys

name: layer.create_adjustment
description: Create an adjustment layer (a comp-sized solid with adjustmentLayer on) — the carrier for comp-wide effects such as Posterize Time or a color grade. Add effects with effect.add.

name: layer.create_camera
description: Create a camera layer.

name: layer.create_footage
description: Add an existing project item (footage or comp) as a layer in a composition.

params.name: sourceItemId
params.description: Project item id to use as source

name: layer.create_light
description: Create a light layer.

name: layer.create_null
description: Create a null object layer.

name: layer.create_parametric_mesh
description: Create a parametric 3D mesh layer (LayerCollection.addParametricMesh, AE 26.3+): cube|sphere|plane|cylinder|cone|torus. Best rendered with the Advanced 3D renderer (comp.set_renderer).

name: layer.create_shape
description: Create an empty shape layer.

name: layer.create_solid
description: Create a solid layer in a composition.

name: layer.create_text
description: Create a text layer: point text by default, paragraph (box) text when boxSize is given, vertical when orientation='vertical' (AE 24.2+). Point<->box conversion is not scriptable, so pick the right kind here.

params.name: boxSize
params.description: [width, height] — creates paragraph (box) text instead of point text

params.name: boxPosition
params.description: [x, y] top-left of the box in layer space (box text only)

name: layer.delete
description: Delete layers. comp supports pattern ('review_id_*'). layer supports index, name, 'selected', 'all'.

name: layer.duplicate
description: Duplicate a layer. Returns the new layer's index.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: layer.info
description: Full layer info incl. property trees and keyframes (same payload as ae_layer_info). Layer by 1-based index or name. detail='summary' drops default-value properties; includeProperties=false skips the tree entirely.

params.name: includeProperties
params.description: Walk the full property tree (default true)

params.name: detail
params.description: full|summary — 'summary' omits properties still at their default value (default full)

name: layer.list_guides
description: List a layer's Layer-panel ruler guides with orientation and position (AE 16.1+).

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: layer.move
description: Move a layer to a new stacking position (1 = top).

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based current layer index, or the layer name

name: layer.move_guide
description: Move an existing Layer-panel ruler guide to a new position (Layer.setGuide). Named move_guide because layer.set_guide already means the guide-LAYER flag.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: layer.remove_guide
description: Remove a Layer-panel ruler guide by its 0-based index (see layer.list_guides).

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: layer.replace_source
description: Replace a layer's source with another project item (footage or comp), keeping keyframes/effects. Set fixExpressions=false to skip expression rewriting.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: item
params.description: New source: project item id (number) or name (string)

params.name: fixExpressions
params.description: Rewrite expressions that reference the old source (default true)

name: layer.scene_edit_detection
description: Run Scene Edit Detection on a video layer (Layer.doSceneEditDetection, AE 22.3+): find cuts in edited footage and mark or split at them.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: mode
params.description: markers (add layer markers) | split (split layer) | splitPrecomp (split + precompose each) | none (detect only)

name: layer.set_anchor
description: Move the anchor point WITHOUT moving the layer on screen (Position is compensated through Scale/Rotation; Position keyframes are all shifted). Address the anchor by preset on the layer's rendered bounds (sourceRectAtTime), by an explicit layer-space point, or by an offset from the current anchor.

params.name: layer
params.description: Layer index, name, { id }, 'selected', 'all', or an array of those

params.name: preset
params.description: center | topLeft | topCenter | topRight | centerLeft | centerRight | bottomLeft | bottomCenter | bottomRight

params.name: point
params.description: [x, y] (or [x, y, z]) explicit anchor in layer space

params.name: offset
params.description: [dx, dy] added to the current anchor

params.name: time
params.description: Time at which the bounds are measured for a preset (default: current comp time)

name: layer.set_blend_mode
description: Set blending mode on a layer.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: layer.set_enabled
description: Enable or disable a layer by name or index. Can target all comps matching a pattern.

params.name: comp
params.description: Comp name/id, or '*' for all comps, or 'review_id_*' for pattern match

name: layer.set_guide
description: Set guideLayer on/off for a layer. Can target all comps matching a pattern.

params.name: comp
params.description: Comp name/id, or '*' for all comps, or 'review_id_*' for pattern match

name: layer.set_parent
description: Set or clear a layer's parent. By default AE compensates the child's transform so it doesn't move; jump=true skips compensation (setParentWithJump) so the child adopts the parent's space.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based child layer index, or the layer name

params.name: parentLayer
params.description: 1-based parent layer index or name. Pass null or 0 to unparent.

params.name: jump
params.description: true = no transform compensation (setParentWithJump). Default false.

name: layer.set_props
description: Set basic layer properties. layer can be index, name, 'selected', or 'all'. Enum-valued attributes accept string names: quality (best|draft|wireframe), samplingQuality (bilinear|bicubic), frameBlendingType (off|frameMix|pixelMotion), autoOrient (off|alongPath|cameraOrPointOfInterest|charactersTowardCamera), blendingMode, lightType (spot|parallel|point|ambient|environment).

params.name: props
params.description: Object with keys to set, e.g. { name: 'foo', enabled: false, label: 5, threeDLayer: true }

name: layer.set_timing
description: Set a layer's timing in one call: shift (relative move of the whole layer), startTime, inPoint, outPoint ('comp' = comp start / comp end — e.g. to extend a layer copied out of a shorter comp), stretch. Applied in that order; AE clamps in/out to the source for footage.

params.name: layer
params.description: Layer index, name, { id }, 'selected', 'all', or an array of those

params.name: shift
params.description: Seconds to move the layer by (in/out points follow)

params.name: inPoint
params.description: In point in seconds, or 'comp' for the comp start (0)

params.name: outPoint
params.description: Out point in seconds, or 'comp' for the comp end (comp.duration)

name: layer.set_track_matte
description: Set (or remove) a track matte on a layer. Uses AVLayer.setTrackMatte (AE 23.0+): the matte can be ANY layer in the comp — it does not need to sit directly above the target.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based index (or name) of the layer to apply matte TO

params.name: matteLayer
params.description: Matte source layer: 1-based index or name. Ignored when matteType is 'none'.

name: layer.set_visibility_schedule
description: Show layers only during given time ranges — sequential pops, material swaps, flip-books — in one call. mode 'opacity' (default) writes HOLD opacity keys (on inside each range, off outside; existing opacity keys replaced); mode 'inOut' sets in/out points (one range per layer).

params.name: entries
params.description: [{ layer, ranges: [[start, end], …] }] — layer accepts the usual index | name | { id } | 'selected' | 'all' | array

name: layer.split
description: Split a layer at a given time. Creates a new layer that starts at the split time.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: time
params.description: Time in seconds to split at

name: layer.split_groups
description: Split a shape layer into one layer per top-level vector group (letters of a word, parts of a character), keeping every group's transform, fills and strokes. New layers stack in group order directly above the original. `anchor` re-anchors each new layer to its own artwork without moving it on screen.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, name, or { id } (a shape layer)

params.name: groups
params.description: 1-based indices of the groups to split out (default: every top-level group)

params.name: anchor
params.description: keep | center | topLeft | topCenter | topRight | centerLeft | centerRight | bottomLeft | bottomCenter | bottomRight — anchor each new layer on its own bounds (default keep)

params.name: nameTemplate
params.description: Name for each new layer; tokens {group}, {layer}, {index} (default '{group}')

params.name: keepOriginal
params.description: Leave the source layer in place (default false: it is removed once split)

name: marker.add_comp
description: Add a marker to a composition at a given time.

params.name: frameTarget
params.description: Web link frame target (used with url)

params.name: eventCuePoint
params.description: true = event cue point, false = navigation cue point

params.name: params
params.description: Cue point key/value parameters, e.g. { "speaker": "A" } (values stringified)

name: marker.add_layer
description: Add a marker to a layer at a given time.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: frameTarget
params.description: Web link frame target (used with url)

params.name: eventCuePoint
params.description: true = event cue point, false = navigation cue point

params.name: params
params.description: Cue point key/value parameters, e.g. { "speaker": "A" } (values stringified)

name: marker.list
description: List all markers on a comp (default) or a layer (pass layer).

params.name: layer
params.description: Layer index or name — omit for comp markers

name: marker.remove
description: Remove a marker from a comp (default) or a layer (pass layer). Target by keyIndex or nearest time.

params.name: layer
params.description: Layer index or name — omit for comp markers

params.name: time
params.description: Remove the marker nearest to this time (used when keyIndex omitted)

name: marker.update
description: Update fields of an existing marker on a comp (default) or a layer (pass layer). Target by keyIndex or nearest time. Only the passed fields change.

params.name: layer
params.description: Layer index or name — omit for comp markers

params.name: time
params.description: Update the marker nearest to this time (used when keyIndex omitted)

params.name: frameTarget
params.description: Web link frame target (used with url)

params.name: eventCuePoint
params.description: true = event cue point, false = navigation cue point

params.name: params
params.description: Cue point key/value parameters, e.g. { "speaker": "A" } (values stringified)

name: mask.add
description: Add a new mask to a layer. With shape ('ellipse'|'rect') + size (+ center) the mask path is built right away — mode/inverted can be set in the same call. Returns the mask index; animate the path afterwards with mask.set_path { time }.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: shape
params.description: ellipse|rect — build the path from center/size instead of vertices

params.name: center
params.description: [x, y] center in layer space (default: source center for footage/solids, [0,0] for shape/text layers)

name: mask.remove
description: Remove a mask from a layer by its 1-based index.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: mask.set_path
description: Set a mask's path — from vertices (+ tangents), or geometrically from shape ('ellipse'|'rect') + size (+ center, roundness). With `time` the path is written as a keyframe, so two calls (small size at t0, large at t1) make a wipe. Vertices/center are in layer space.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: vertices
params.description: Array of [x,y] points (omit when using shape/size)

params.name: shape
params.description: ellipse|rect — build the path from center/size instead of vertices

params.name: center
params.description: [x, y] center in layer space (default: source center for footage/solids, [0,0] for shape/text layers)

params.name: time
params.description: Write the path as a keyframe at this time instead of the static value

params.name: inTangents
params.description: Array of [x,y] in-tangent offsets (same length as vertices)

params.name: featherSegLocs
params.description: Variable-width feather: 0-based segment index per feather point

params.name: featherRelSegLocs
params.description: Variable-width feather: relative position (0-1) on the segment, per point

params.name: featherRadii
params.description: Variable-width feather: radius in px per point. Sign must match featherTypes: outer points (type 0) need radius >= 0, inner points (type 1) need radius <= 0 — AE rejects mismatches

params.name: featherTensions
params.description: Variable-width feather: tension 0-1 per point (default all 0)

params.name: featherRelCornerAngles
params.description: Variable-width feather: relative corner angle % per point (default all 0)

name: mask.set_props
description: Set mask properties: mode, feather, opacity, expansion, inverted, locked, color, rotoBezier, motionBlur, featherFalloff.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: locked
params.description: Lock the mask against UI editing

params.name: color
params.description: [r,g,b] 0-1 mask outline color in the UI

params.name: rotoBezier
params.description: Treat the path as a RotoBezier (tangents auto-computed)

name: pref.delete
description: Delete one After Effects preference (app.preferences.deletePref).

params.name: prefType
params.description: Preferences file: machineSpecific (default) | machineIndependent | machineIndependentRender | machineIndependentOutput | machineIndependentComposition | machineSpecificText | machineSpecificPaint

params.name: confirm
params.description: Must be true. This operation changes the user's After Effects APPLICATION configuration (it persists beyond the project) — set it only when the user explicitly requested this change, never as a side effect of other work.

name: pref.get
description: Read one After Effects preference (app.preferences.getPrefAs*). Section/key names match the prefs file, e.g. section "Main Pref Section v2", key "Pref_SCOPES_ENABLE_DYNAMIC_PEAK". Returns exists=false instead of failing when the pref is absent.

params.name: prefType
params.description: Preferences file: machineSpecific (default) | machineIndependent | machineIndependentRender | machineIndependentOutput | machineIndependentComposition | machineSpecificText | machineSpecificPaint

name: pref.get_setting
description: Read a script-scoped setting (app.settings.getSetting) — the persistent key/value store AE offers to scripts, separate from application preferences.

name: pref.set
description: Write one After Effects preference (app.preferences.savePrefAs*) and flush to disk. A wrong value can misconfigure AE until preferences are reset — read the current value with pref.get first.

params.name: prefType
params.description: Preferences file: machineSpecific (default) | machineIndependent | machineIndependentRender | machineIndependentOutput | machineIndependentComposition | machineSpecificText | machineSpecificPaint

params.name: persist
params.description: Flush prefs to disk immediately (default true)

params.name: confirm
params.description: Must be true. This operation changes the user's After Effects APPLICATION configuration (it persists beyond the project) — set it only when the user explicitly requested this change, never as a side effect of other work.

name: pref.set_setting
description: Write a script-scoped setting (app.settings.saveSetting). Values are stored as strings.

params.name: confirm
params.description: Must be true. This operation changes the user's After Effects APPLICATION configuration (it persists beyond the project) — set it only when the user explicitly requested this change, never as a side effect of other work.

name: project.auto_fix_expressions
description: Find and replace text in all expressions across the project. Useful after renaming layers/comps.

name: project.clear
description: Remove ALL items from the project. Destructive — use with caution.

name: project.consolidate_footage
description: Merge duplicate footage items into one and update layer references (Project.consolidateFootage).

name: project.delete_item
description: Delete a project item by id.

name: project.find_layers
description: Search layers by name pattern and/or type across one or all comps.

params.name: comp
params.description: Restrict to one comp (name or id). Omit to search all.

params.name: namePattern
params.description: Case-insensitive substring match on layer name

name: project.get_settings
description: Read project-wide settings: color depth, expression engine, working color space, time display. Pass includeColorProfiles=true to list installed color profile names.

params.name: includeColorProfiles
params.description: Also return installed color profile names (default false)

name: project.get_tool
description: Read the active tool in the Tools panel (Project.toolType, AE 14.0+).

name: project.get_xmp
description: Read the project's XMP metadata packet (Project.xmpPacket) as an RDF/XML string.

name: project.import_file
description: Import a file (image, video, audio) into the project as footage. Pass sequence=true with the first file of an image sequence to import the whole sequence.

params.name: sequence
params.description: Import as image sequence starting at path (default false)

params.name: forceAlphabetical
params.description: Sequence only: force alphabetical order (default false)

params.name: importAs
params.description: footage|comp|compRetainLayerSizes|project — for layered files like .psd/.ai (default footage)

params.name: rangeStart
params.description: Sequence only: first frame number to import (ImportOptions.rangeStart)

params.name: rangeEnd
params.description: Sequence only: last frame number to import (ImportOptions.rangeEnd)

name: project.import_placeholder
description: Create a placeholder footage item (Project.importPlaceholder) to build comps before the real footage exists. Relink later with footage.replace.

name: project.list_effects
description: List available effect matchNames in the running AE. Uses app.effects if available, otherwise a curated list.

name: project.merge
description: Import another .aep into the current project as a folder (After Effects' own project import): every comp, footage item and folder of `path` lands under one new folder with names preserved, and nothing already in the project is touched. This is how work done in another instance comes back — save there, merge here, then move or swap comps as needed (project.delete_item / item ops). Returns the folder and the comps and items it now holds.

params.name: path
params.description: Absolute .aep path (saved by the other instance)

params.name: folderName
params.description: Rename the imported folder (default: the .aep's file name)

params.name: parentFolder
params.description: Folder (id or name) to put the imported folder into (default: project root)

name: project.new
description: Create a NEW empty project (app.newProject). Refuses to replace unsaved work unless save=true succeeds or discardUnsaved=true is explicit.

params.name: save
params.description: Save the current project before closing (default false; needs a file path)

params.name: discardUnsaved
params.description: Explicitly discard current unsaved work (default false)

name: project.open
description: Open a .aep project file. Refuses to replace unsaved work unless save=true succeeds or discardUnsaved=true is explicit.

params.name: save
params.description: Save current project before closing (requires an existing file path; default false)

params.name: discardUnsaved
params.description: Explicitly discard current unsaved work (default false)

name: project.parse_swatch
description: Parse an Adobe swatch file (.ase) and return its colors (app.parseSwatchFile) - feed brand palettes to fills, solids, and text colors.

name: project.purge
description: Purge AE memory/disk caches. Use when AE is consuming too much RAM.

name: project.reduce
description: Reduce the project to only the given comps and everything they use (Project.reduceProject). Removes all other items — save a copy first.

params.name: comps
params.description: Comp names or ids to keep

name: project.remove_unused_footage
description: Remove all footage items that are not used in any comp (Project.removeUnusedFootage).

name: project.rename
description: Rename project items and/or layers in bulk: an exact `map` ({ from: to }) or a regex `pattern` + `replacement` ($1 works). scope 'items' covers comps, footage and folders; 'layers' covers layers in every comp (or the comps matched by `comp`). dryRun previews without renaming.

params.name: pattern
params.description: Regular expression (JavaScript syntax) applied to each name

params.name: flags
params.description: Regex flags: any of g, i, m (default 'g')

params.name: comp
params.description: Restrict layer renames to these comps (name/id/pattern/array; default all)

params.name: itemTypes
params.description: Restrict item renames to these types: CompItem|FootageItem|FolderItem

params.name: dryRun
params.description: Report what would change without renaming (default false)

name: project.replace_font
description: Replace a font throughout the entire project. Useful for font substitution.

params.name: fromFont
params.description: Current font postscript name to replace

name: project.set_default_import_folder
description: Set the folder shown by default in the file import dialog (Project.setDefaultImportFolder).

params.name: confirm
params.description: Must be true. This operation changes the user's After Effects APPLICATION configuration (it persists beyond the project) — set it only when the user explicitly requested this change, never as a side effect of other work.

name: project.set_memory_limits
description: Set AE memory usage limits (app.setMemoryUsageLimits): image cache percent and maximum memory percent. Percentages over 100 are allowed (AE interprets them against installed RAM).

params.name: imageCachePercent
params.description: Image cache size as % of installed RAM

params.name: maxMemoryPercent
params.description: Maximum AE memory as % of installed RAM

params.name: confirm
params.description: Must be true. This operation changes the user's After Effects APPLICATION configuration (it persists beyond the project) — set it only when the user explicitly requested this change, never as a side effect of other work.

name: project.set_multi_frame_rendering
description: Configure Multi-Frame Rendering (app.setMultiFrameRenderingConfig, AE 22.0+): on/off and the maximum CPU percentage MFR may use.

params.name: confirm
params.description: Must be true. This operation changes the user's After Effects APPLICATION configuration (it persists beyond the project) — set it only when the user explicitly requested this change, never as a side effect of other work.

name: project.set_settings
description: Set project-wide settings: color depth, expression engine, working color space, time display.

params.name: workingSpace
params.description: Working color space name (see project.get_settings includeColorProfiles), or '' for None

params.name: displayStartFrame
params.description: Frame count starts at 0 or 1 (when counting frames)

name: project.set_tool
description: Set the active tool in the Tools panel (Project.toolType, AE 14.0+): selection|rotate|hand|zoom|panBehind|rect|roundedRect|ellipse|polygon|star|textHorizontal|textVertical|pen|maskFeather|brush|cloneStamp|eraser|puppetPin|puppetStarch|puppetBend|puppetAdvanced|puppetOverlap|cameraUnified|cameraOrbit|cameraTrackXY|cameraTrackZ|cameraOrbitCursor|cameraOrbitScene|cameraOrbitCamera|cameraPanCursor.

params.name: confirm
params.description: Must be true. This operation changes the user's After Effects APPLICATION configuration (it persists beyond the project) — set it only when the user explicitly requested this change, never as a side effect of other work.

name: project.set_xmp
description: Replace the project's XMP metadata packet (Project.xmpPacket). Pass a complete, well-formed RDF/XML packet - AE does not validate fragments.

name: project.undo
description: Undo the last action. Equivalent to Ctrl+Z. Each prior ae_do call is ONE undo step (its automatic undo group), so count=1 reverts the whole previous call, batch included.

name: property.add
description: Add a property to an indexed group by matchName (PropertyGroup.addProperty). Unlocks text animators ('ADBE Text Animator' on ["Text","Animators"]), layer styles, shape contents, etc. Use property.list to discover group paths.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: property
params.description: Path to the group to add into, e.g. ["Text","Animators"]. Use [] for layer root.

params.name: matchName
params.description: Match name (or display name) of the property to add, e.g. "ADBE Text Animator". NOTE: adding to an indexed group re-creates it, invalidating prior property references.

name: property.get
description: Get the current value of any layer property by path.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: time
params.description: If set, get value at this time (for animated properties)

name: property.list
description: List child properties/groups at a given path. Useful for discovering what's inside a property group.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: property
params.description: Property path to a group. Use [] for the layer root.

name: property.move
description: Reorder a property within its parent INDEXED group (PropertyBase.moveTo): masks, shape contents, text animators. For effects use effect.move.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: property
params.description: Path to the property to move (a member of an indexed group)

params.name: toIndex
params.description: 1-based target position within the parent group

name: property.remove
description: Remove a property or group by path (Property.remove). Works on members of indexed groups: effects, masks, shape contents, text animators, layer styles.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: property
params.description: Path to the property to remove

name: property.select
description: Select or deselect a property in the timeline (PropertyBase.selected) - stages it for UI-side actions and makes it visible with the U-shortcut workflow.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: property.separate_dimensions
description: Separate (or rejoin) the dimensions of a multi-dimensional property such as Position. When separated, animate the followers (e.g. X Position) individually.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: property.set
description: Set any layer property by path. layer can be index, name, 'selected', or 'all'.

name: render.add_to_queue
description: Add a composition to the render queue. Optionally set output path.

params.name: outputPath
params.description: Output file path (optional, sets on the first output module)

name: render.clear_queue
description: Remove all items from the render queue.

name: render.duplicate_item
description: Duplicate a render-queue item (RenderQueueItem.duplicate) — e.g. to render the same comp with a second settings/output combination.

name: render.frame
description: Render one frame to PNG (raw saveFrameToPng). As the LAST child of a batch.run, one call mutates and hands back visual proof. outPath must be absolute; raise ae_do's timeoutMs for slow renders. CAUTION: in color-managed projects (project.get_settings workingSpace != 'None') this writes raw working-space values that look dark/wrong — use the ae_render_frame TOOL there, which converts to display sRGB.

params.name: outPath
params.description: Absolute path for the PNG (parent directories are created)

name: render.get_settings
description: Read the raw render settings of a queue item and the settings of each of its output modules (getSettings, AE 13.0+). format 'settable' returns only keys accepted by render.set_settings / render.set_om_settings.

name: render.list_templates
description: List available render-settings templates and output-module templates. The render queue must have at least one item (templates are read from a queue item).

name: render.queue_in_ame
description: Send the render queue to Adobe Media Encoder (for H.264/HEVC etc.). Requires AME installed. renderImmediately=true starts the AME queue.

params.name: renderImmediately
params.description: Start rendering in AME right away (default false)

name: render.remove_item
description: Remove ONE item from the render queue by its 1-based index (render.clear_queue removes all).

params.name: queueIndex
params.description: 1-based queue item index (explicit — no default for a destructive op)

name: render.save_template
description: Save a queue item's current render settings, or an output module's current settings, as a named template (saveAsTemplate) for reuse via render.set_output.

params.name: confirm
params.description: Must be true. This operation changes the user's After Effects APPLICATION configuration (it persists beyond the project) — set it only when the user explicitly requested this change, never as a side effect of other work.

name: render.set_om_settings
description: Set raw output-module settings on a queue item (OutputModule.setSettings, AE 13.0+), e.g. { "Format": "QuickTime", "Channels": "RGB + Alpha" }. Discover valid keys/values with render.get_settings.

name: render.set_output
description: Configure a render-queue item: render/output templates, output path, time span, render flag, skipFrames, logType, postRenderAction. Discover template names with render.list_templates; raw settings via render.get_settings / render.set_settings.

params.name: renderTemplate
params.description: Render settings template name (e.g. "Best Settings", "Draft Settings")

params.name: timeSpanStart
params.description: Render span start in seconds (comp time)

params.name: render
params.description: Whether this item renders when the queue starts (the Render checkbox)

params.name: skipFrames
params.description: Render every Nth frame (0 = every frame)

params.name: includeSourceXMP
params.description: Embed source-footage XMP metadata in the output

name: render.set_settings
description: Set raw render settings on a queue item (RenderQueueItem.setSettings, AE 13.0+), e.g. { "Quality": "Best", "Resolution": "Half" }. Discover valid keys/values with render.get_settings.

name: render.start
description: Start rendering the render queue. Blocks until complete. Missing output directories are created first (AE itself fails with 'Directory does not exist').

name: render.status
description: Report the render queue state: per-item status, time spans, and output paths.

name: render.variants
description: Render the same comp several times with different property values — a slider that switches a state, a text that changes per version — in ONE call. Each variant sets its values (static properties only; keyed ones are refused), renders through a temporary queue item to outputPath with {name}/{index} substituted, then the original values are restored. Other queue items are not rendered. Blocks until done: raise timeoutMs.

params.name: variants
params.description: [{ name, sets: [{ layer, property, value }, …] }, …] — e.g. [{ name: "A", sets: [{ layer: "Ctrl", property: ["Effects","Slider Control","Slider"], value: 1 }] }]

params.name: outputPath
params.description: Output file path template; {name} and {index} are replaced per variant

name: shape.add_ellipse
description: Add an Ellipse Path to a shape group.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: shape.add_fill
description: Add a Fill to a shape group.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: shape.add_gradient_fill
description: Add a Gradient Fill to a shape group. Type and start/end points are scriptable; color stops are NOT scriptable in AE (defaults to white-to-black — edit stops manually or via a preset).

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: shape.add_gradient_stroke
description: Add a Gradient Stroke to a shape group. Type, points, and width are scriptable; color stops are NOT scriptable in AE.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: shape.add_group
description: Add a Vector Group to a shape layer's Contents.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index or name (must be a shape layer)

name: shape.add_merge_paths
description: Add Merge Paths to a shape group for combining/subtracting shapes.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: shape.add_offset_paths
description: Add Offset Paths to a shape group (grow/shrink outlines).

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: amount
params.description: Offset in px (positive grows, negative shrinks)

name: shape.add_path
description: Add a custom bezier Path (vertices + tangents) to a shape group.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: shape.add_polystar
description: Add a Polystar Path (star or polygon) to a shape group.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: innerRadius
params.description: Inner radius in px (star type only)

name: shape.add_pucker_bloat
description: Add Pucker & Bloat to a shape group (negative = pucker, positive = bloat).

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: shape.add_rect
description: Add a Rectangle Path to a shape group.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: shape.add_repeater
description: Add a Repeater to a shape group — duplicates the group's contents with a per-copy transform offset.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: shape.add_rounded_corners
description: Add Rounded Corners to a shape group.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: shape.add_stroke
description: Add a Stroke to a shape group.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: shape.add_trim_paths
description: Add Trim Paths to a shape group. Essential for shape animation (line draw-on effects).

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: shape.add_twist
description: Add Twist to a shape group.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: shape.add_wiggle_paths
description: Add Wiggle Paths (roughen) to a shape group.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: shape.add_wiggle_transform
description: Add Wiggle Transform to a shape group - randomizes position/scale/rotation over time (the transform-space sibling of Wiggle Paths).

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: shape.add_zigzag
description: Add Zig Zag to a shape group.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: shape.group_bounds
description: Bounds of each top-level vector group of a shape layer, in LAYER space with the group's own transform applied — what you need to split, align, or anchor per part. Geometry-based (exact for paths/rects/ellipses; strokes padded in; stars and path modifiers such as Trim/Repeater are listed in `approximate`). Also reports the whole layer's bounds.

params.name: layer
params.description: Layer index, name, { id }, 'selected', 'all', or an array of those (shape layers)

params.name: time
params.description: Evaluate animated paths/transforms at this time (default: current value)

params.name: includeStroke
params.description: Pad by half the widest stroke (default true)

name: shape.recolor
description: Replace fill and/or stroke colors throughout a shape layer's contents (any nesting depth). Either `color` (paint everything one color — silhouettes) or `map` ([{ from, to }] — per-color substitution, matched within `tolerance`). Colors are [r,g,b] 0-1 (alpha optional).

params.name: layer
params.description: Layer index, name, { id }, 'selected', 'all', or an array of those (shape layers)

params.name: color
params.description: [r,g,b] — set every matching fill/stroke to this color

params.name: map
params.description: [{ from: [r,g,b], to: [r,g,b] }, …] — replace only colors that match `from`

name: shape.signature
description: Structural hash of a shape layer's contents and of each top-level group — matchNames plus rounded values, NO display names — so identical artwork hashes the same even after renaming. Use it to find duplicate layers when merging comps, or to check that a copy still matches its source.

params.name: layer
params.description: Layer index, name, { id }, 'selected', 'all', or an array of those (shape layers)

params.name: precision
params.description: Decimal places kept when rounding values (default 2)

params.name: time
params.description: Evaluate animated values at this time (default: current value)

params.name: includeLayerTransform
params.description: Also hash the layer's Transform group (default false — copies usually differ only in position)

name: text.add_animator
description: Add a text animator with animated properties and a selector. properties maps animator matchNames to initial values, e.g. {"ADBE Text Position 3D": [0,-50,0], "ADBE Text Opacity": 0}. Common: Position 3D, Scale 3D, Rotation, Opacity, Fill Color, Tracking Amount, Blur.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name (must be a TextLayer)

params.name: properties
params.description: Map of animator-property matchName to initial value

name: text.add_font_axis
description: Add a variable-font axis property to a text animator (PropertyGroup.addVariableFontAxis, AE 26.0+) so the axis can be animated/keyframed. Targets an existing animator by 1-based index or name, or creates a new one.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: animator
params.description: Existing animator (1-based index or name). Omit to create a new animator.

name: text.measure
description: Measure a text layer's composed layout: line/paragraph counts and character spans, per-line baselines (baselineLocs), box overflow. Range data needs AE 24.3+; missing fields come back null.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: text.paste_range
description: Paste the TEXT AND STYLING of one character range into another (CharacterRange.pasteFrom, AE 25.1+) — replaces the target range's content. Source defaults to the same layer; pass sourceLayer to copy across layers.

params.name: layer
params.description: TARGET text layer (1-based index or name)

params.name: end
params.description: Target range end (exclusive; default: end of text)

params.name: sourceLayer
params.description: SOURCE text layer (default: same as layer)

params.name: sourceEnd
params.description: Source range end (exclusive; default: end of source text)

name: text.reset_style
description: Reset a text layer's styling to the default Character and/or Paragraph panel settings (TextDocument.resetCharStyle / resetParagraphStyle).

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: text.set_box
description: Resize, reposition, or configure the box of a paragraph (box) text layer, including the AE 24.6 auto-fit and alignment controls. Point<->box conversion is NOT scriptable in AE — create the layer as box text from the start (layer.create_text with boxSize).

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: boxPosition
params.description: [x, y] top-left of the box in layer space (AE 14.0+)

params.name: firstBaselineAlignmentMinimum
params.description: Manual minimum offset of the first composed line (AE 24.6+)

params.name: insetSpacing
params.description: Inset spacing between box bounds and text, px (AE 24.6+)

name: text.set_content
description: Set the text content of a text layer.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index or name (must be a TextLayer)

name: text.set_style
description: Set text styling on the whole document: font, fontSize, colors, tracking, leading, justification, caps, kerning, ligatures, paragraph indents/spacing, RTL direction, vertical baselines, digit set, and more. For a sub-range use text.set_style_range.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: allCaps
params.description: All caps via fontCapsOption (setter needs AE 24.0+)

params.name: smallCaps
params.description: Small caps via fontCapsOption (setter needs AE 24.0+)

params.name: tsume
params.description: Tsume (normalized 0-1, CJK spacing, setter needs AE 24.0+)

name: text.set_style_range
description: Style a SUB-RANGE of a text layer (AE 24.3+): same attributes as text.set_style, applied to characters, paragraphs, or composed lines. Whole-document-only attributes (lineOrientation) are rejected by AE with a warning.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: start
params.description: 0-based start index (character, paragraph, or composed line)

params.name: end
params.description: Exclusive end index. Default: characters → end of text; paragraphs/lines → start+1

params.name: allCaps
params.description: All caps via fontCapsOption (setter needs AE 24.0+)

params.name: smallCaps
params.description: Small caps via fontCapsOption (setter needs AE 24.0+)

params.name: tsume
params.description: Tsume (normalized 0-1, CJK spacing, setter needs AE 24.0+)

name: text.set_variable_font
description: Set variable-font design axes on a text layer (AE 24.0+). axes maps axis tags to values, e.g. { "wght": 700, "wdth": 85 }. Unspecified axes keep their current values. Discover a font's axes with font.info (designAxesData).

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: timeline.select_layers
description: Select (or deselect) layers in a comp by index.

params.name: indices
params.description: Array of 1-based layer indices to select

params.name: deselectOthers
params.description: Deselect all other layers first (default true)

name: timeline.set_active_comp
description: Set the active (visible in UI) composition. Opens it in the viewer.

name: timeline.set_time
description: Set the current time indicator (CTI) in a composition.

name: transform.set
description: Set transform properties on one or more layers. layer can be index, name, 'selected', or 'all'. For keyframes use keyframe.add.

name: viewer.get_state
description: Read the active viewer's state: type, zoom, exposure, channels.

name: viewer.set_options
description: Set active-viewer view options: zoom (1 = 100%), exposure (stops), checkerboard, guide/ruler visibility and lock/snap (AE 16.1+), fast-preview mode, and the displayed channels.
